scope: all 78 original practice drafts, manually mapped; 77 proposed standalone cards

categories.title: Understanding
categories.definition: Explain a relationship, mechanism or limit and apply it to a case.
categories.boundary: Not recognition of fluent prose or an AI rating.

categories.title: Independent capability
categories.definition: Perform a chosen skill under explicitly reduced-assistance conditions, including later use.
categories.boundary: An immediate attempt is practice or assessment, not evidence of durable transfer. Keep accommodations.

categories.title: Better-founded judgment
categories.definition: Choose using relevant evidence, alternatives and consequences.
categories.boundary: A checked artifact, consensus or successful outcome alone does not establish improved judgment.

categories.title: Calibration
categories.definition: Bring confidence and reliance into closer relation with available evidence and actual performance.
categories.boundary: Doubt, felt reassurance and numerical confidence ratings alone are not calibration.

categories.title: Authorship and agency
categories.definition: Form purposes, criteria and substantive contributions one can explain, revise or refuse.
categories.boundary: Formal approval, imitation of a voice or a disclosure log alone is insufficient.

categories.title: Creative development
categories.definition: Develop, select and reshape possibilities for an intended creative purpose.
categories.boundary: More suggestions or polished imitation is not improved creativity; range and selection should be observed separately.

categories.title: Directed attention
categories.definition: Spend attention deliberately on chosen work and stop or redirect when appropriate.
categories.boundary: Screen time, discomfort and task throughput alone are not the outcome.

categories.title: Shared understanding
categories.definition: Communicate or reconcile meaning so actual people understand the relevant ideas and differences.
categories.boundary: Simulated audience reactions, persuasion and consensus do not establish shared understanding.

categories.title: Accountability and informed participation
categories.definition: Make authority, contributions, data use and unresolved responsibilities inspectable to those affected.
categories.boundary: Documentation or named ownership alone does not show agency, fairness or compliance.

categories.title: Quality of the immediate work
categories.definition: Make a specific output, process or check more accurate, useful or fit for its purpose.
categories.boundary: Better assisted work does not by itself show stronger thinking or retained capability.

mappings.title: Request criticism without rewriting
mappings.rationale: The writer judges criticism and makes the revisions instead of accepting replacement prose.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Which criticism did you reject, and what purpose did your own revision serve?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Turn creative disagreement into your own checklist
mappings.rationale: The reusable checklist is applied without reopening the assistant; later craft improvement remains untested.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Can you use, explain and sometimes reject a checklist item without consulting the conversation?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Test AI on the work it will do
mappings.rationale: Repeated representative tests can inform warranted reliance on this tool for this task.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Which real task failures did benchmarks or a first good impression miss?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Inspect real errors before automating evaluation
mappings.rationale: Human error inspection and held-out judgments ground evaluation; this primarily improves checking rather than training a person.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: What failure did your own reading reveal before categories and scores existed?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Rehearse a bounded reasoning case
mappings.rationale: The person chooses and explains an answer before feedback in a checked practice case.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Can you identify the decisive premise and what change would alter your answer?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Choose the result before the tool
mappings.rationale: The person defines worthwhile work and chooses assistance for the actual limiting step.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Did the limiting step change, or did the tool only create more material to review?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Develop parallel creative routes before combining them
mappings.rationale: Keeping routes separate exposes alternative framings before a team combines or chooses them.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice which workflow contributed a useful framing and who can explain it. More images is different from a better proposal or preserved capability.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Save your own starting point
mappings.rationale: A revisable initial contribution makes later changes and their reasons inspectable.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Which change came from new evidence, which from a suggestion, and which from your own reconsideration?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Collect independent views before discussion
mappings.rationale: Independent submissions preserve differences that can inform a collective decision.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether the record includes genuinely different estimates and reasons, and whether the final decision is distinguished from everyone’s personal view.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Turn a premortem into actions and stopping criteria
mappings.rationale: Possible failures are translated into chosen actions and stopping criteria, not just a risk list.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether a concern changed an action or stopping rule. A longer risk list is not a safer project.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Answer questions about a belief you hold
mappings.rationale: The person examines premises and checks factual reasons before changing a belief.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Keep the initial and final belief sentences and the reason for any change. A shift in certainty alone is not improvement.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Preserve an AI claim before challenging it
mappings.rationale: An incident record preserves what was actually claimed so later explanations can be checked.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Can you reconstruct the original claim without relying on the model’s later version?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Check correctness and completeness separately
mappings.rationale: Separate inspections target false or unsupported claims and important omissions in a particular answer.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Which flags survive your inspection, and what did the model miss?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Carry one question away from the chat
mappings.rationale: Ending the generation loop creates room for a person to pursue or leave an unresolved thought.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Did you stop when you intended, and did the next useful thought come from you, another person, a source, or more generation?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Check a capability without the assistant
mappings.rationale: Comparable reduced-assistance attempts expose what the person can currently do and what help is needed.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] What can you now explain or perform under the agreed conditions, and what help remains necessary?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Review AI code against independent checks
mappings.rationale: Independent expected behavior and inspection test the code; capability preservation is not directly measured.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Could you explain the expected behavior and find an error without consulting the same model?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Keep one thinking step for yourself
mappings.rationale: The person chooses and performs a valued contribution; a retained step is an opportunity for practice, not proof of skill.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] What did you actually choose or work out during the protected step, and was that what you intended to keep?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Define the delegation before the agent starts
mappings.rationale: The brief makes authority, completion criteria, checkpoints and return of control explicit.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Did you define an inspectable result, and did control return when it could not be met?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.
mappings.integration_note: Existing Mollick source entry has a pending correction; approve the focused update before relying on that canonical entry.

mappings.title: Choose the human part of the work
mappings.rationale: The same retained-contribution choice is already covered by keep-one-thinking-step; preserve this source as a variant.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Which substantive choice remained yours, and could you explain it without quoting AI?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Teach a simulated learner
mappings.rationale: Explaining and applying a framework requires the person to generate an account rather than read another explanation.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] What did you have to work out yourself, and could you apply it to a different case?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Test and share a team AI workflow
mappings.rationale: Testing and sharing failure conditions makes the workflow usable by others; retained capability needs a separate check.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether coworkers can identify failure conditions and adapt the workflow, not only reproduce its best demonstration.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Count the cost of review before delegating
mappings.rationale: A full-work comparison informs the choice to delegate instead of equating generation speed with useful savings.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: How much time went to review and recovery, and could you judge the result?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.
mappings.integration_note: Existing Mollick source entry has a pending correction; remove unsupported comparison and validation claims before reuse.

mappings.title: Use a prototype to brief a developer
mappings.rationale: A concrete but explicitly incomplete prototype helps the person and developer discuss intended behavior and unknowns.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: What became clearer, and what still needs expert investigation?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Curate context and clarify before drafting
mappings.rationale: Relevant context and corrected assumptions improve the immediate brief; no independent learning outcome is built in.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Which assumption did clarification expose, and did the correction survive into the artifact?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Choose an argument before drafting from your archive
mappings.rationale: The writer compares possible arguments and decides what the available archive can support before drafting.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether you can explain why you rejected the other routes and whether the chosen argument is actually supported by your material.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Articulate your writing preferences through examples
mappings.rationale: Concrete examples make the person's editing criteria expressible and revisable, rather than delegating identity to a profile.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether you can now explain an editing choice more precisely without the profile. A convincing imitation is a different outcome.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Reset a drifting conversation
mappings.rationale: A corrected brief addresses a failed interaction; a fresh conversation alone does not improve the user's thinking.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Did the brief correct an identifiable problem or merely produce a more agreeable answer?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Record a workflow before turning it into instructions
mappings.rationale: Explaining actual steps and exceptions makes tacit work inspectable before a generated procedure hardens it.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Which exception or judgment did the first draft miss?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Keep a document and question tracker
mappings.rationale: The record separates document statements, unanswered questions and confirmations from accountable people.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Can you distinguish a document statement, an open question and a confirmed answer?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Settle the strategy before requesting a draft
mappings.rationale: An accountable professional chooses the substantive approach before generated wording makes it appear settled.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Which strategic choice did you make before polished text made it seem inevitable?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Preview and approve before publishing
mappings.rationale: Inspection of the actual artifact catches errors before release; approval alone is not intellectual agency.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: Which problem appeared only when you inspected the artifact?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Answer AI questions with real evidence
mappings.rationale: Missing facts are sought in records and with people rather than replaced by model confidence.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: What real evidence changed the decision, and which assumption remains unresolved?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Name consequences before delegating
mappings.rationale: The person examines who bears consequences and whether authority and recovery mechanisms are real.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Can you point to the actual approval and recovery mechanism, rather than a statement that a human is in charge?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Keep your sensory association in the work
mappings.rationale: The user decides whether a generated scene preserves their intended expression; the model does not validate perception.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Identify one place where the system preserved or flattened your association. Keep subjective expression distinct from factual verification.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Ask children about AI before setting rules
mappings.rationale: Listening lets affected children inform a rule while adults retain their responsibilities.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether the discussion reveals an assumption you had wrong. This is participation in rule-making, not evidence that every use should be allowed.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Map a return path before choosing
mappings.rationale: Concrete and verified return constraints make a choice more assessable than generic reassurance.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether the return path became more specific, rather than merely more reassuring. Keep unresolved constraints visible.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Build the opposing case yourself
mappings.rationale: The learner constructs the argument themselves after receiving an objection, leaving reasoning work with the learner.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Can the learner reconstruct the opposing argument and identify the evidence that matters without reading AI’s text?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Make AI disclosure specific and reciprocal
mappings.rationale: Specific reciprocal disclosure makes contributions and responsibility inspectable without promising trust gains.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Can someone tell which work and judgments were actually yours? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Diagnose your draft before feedback
mappings.rationale: Comparing a prior diagnosis with checked feedback exposes discrepancies in self-assessment.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] What changed between your diagnosis and the reconstruction, and can you point to why?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Use fictional questions for your own reflection
mappings.rationale: The person writes their own response to an interpretation; emotional resonance cannot certify a truth about them.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice which question led you to something you could support from the text or your own experience. Emotional resonance does not authenticate an interpretation.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Ask for an explanation in a specific case
mappings.rationale: Case application and follow-up expose what the learner can explain beyond polished description.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Can the learner explain what assumption would need to change for their conclusion to fail?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Check missing perspectives against real evidence
mappings.rationale: Outside evidence determines whether an apparent omission matters and warrants changing the answer.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Which specific outside evidence changed the answer? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Ask how workplace disclosures will be used
mappings.rationale: Documented answers about collection and use inform a person's disclosure decision.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Which questions received a documented answer, and which remain unknown? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Define the decision before asking AI to research
mappings.rationale: Research is tied to a consequential question and evidence that could change the choice.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Record which piece of evidence changed a decision, or state that none did. Brevity and apparent actionability are separate from accuracy.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Record the human work needed around AI
mappings.rationale: A contemporaneous record makes corrections and context-dependent human work visible.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] What types of intervention recur, and what would let the team detect them earlier? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Ask how to find out before asking AI
mappings.rationale: The child participates in choosing and pursuing an inquiry route before receiving an answer.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether the child can explain a way to investigate another question. An enjoyable exchange is not evidence of lasting learning.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Use a creative constraint, then make something yourself
mappings.rationale: The person uses an explicitly fictional provocation to make something rather than treating generated associations as knowledge.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice what you added or rejected, not just what the model produced. Forced uncertainty is role-play, not calibrated knowledge.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Ask about the gap, then do the task
mappings.rationale: Explanations address a gap while the person still performs and checks the learning task.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Compare what you predicted you could do with the actual attempt, keeping confidence and performance separate.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Explain it back before the correction
mappings.rationale: An unaided explanation reveals gaps before feedback; later transfer is a separate observation.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Can you explain the concept on a different example, and which parts still require help?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Test one creative change suggested by AI
mappings.rationale: A bounded human revision is compared with the original rather than accepting AI's interpretation of hidden intent.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Compare the changed passage with the saved original and explain what improved or was lost. You may reject the suggestion.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Keep a record of how the writing developed
mappings.rationale: The record reconstructs contributions and choices without claiming conclusive proof of authorship.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Could you reconstruct one important change without relying on memory? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Ask advisers who know the subject and you
mappings.rationale: People with domain and personal context supply reasons and surprises for the person's decision.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] What did a person know that was absent from the initial framing? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Expand agent authority one tested step at a time
mappings.rationale: Observed performance informs a bounded expansion, reduction or retention of authority.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Curator-proposed observation, not a validated measure: What evidence changed authority, including a choice to stop or roll back?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Check what each person thinks was decided
mappings.rationale: Comparing participants' accounts reveals disagreement before owners and actions are recorded.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether unresolved items stay unresolved in the record. Apparent agreement with a displayed summary may hide dissent.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Set creative criteria before generating options
mappings.rationale: The person defines a brief and compares candidates against criteria chosen before attractive options appear.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether criteria changed merely to favor the first attractive candidate. A long idea list is not a measure of creative judgment.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Write a proposal to test the idea
mappings.rationale: Constructing and defending a customer/problem/solution account can expose gaps or justify abandoning an idea.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] What did making the document reveal that a finished template would have hidden? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Match confidence to the evidence you have
mappings.rationale: The person distinguishes enthusiasm from evidence strength and selects a proportionate next check.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Ask what observation would lower confidence. Do not turn the practitioner’s confidence scale into a probability of success.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Rehearse with someone who knows the audience
mappings.rationale: A knowledgeable colleague helps expose gaps in what the speaker can explain to this audience.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Which question exposed a gap in understanding rather than presentation polish? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Ask what an update would change
mappings.rationale: A decision and revisit trigger determine whether investigating an update deserves attention now.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Which update actually changed a decision, and which only consumed attention?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Seek contrary evidence in customer material
mappings.rationale: Actual customer material is used to test a preferred strategy rather than confirm it.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Did a checked contradiction change your choice, or only produce a more persuasive story? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Build the explanatory model yourself
mappings.rationale: Constructing relationships and revising assumptions against results develops an explainable account of the system.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Can you explain why changing one assumption changes the result? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Let the child write the story around supporting images
mappings.rationale: The child performs the chosen writing work while using image support; the account shows participation, not demonstrated learning.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice the writing and choices the child actually did. If drawing is the learning goal, choose a different division of work.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Protect a daily highlight
mappings.rationale: The person allocates feasible time to a chosen activity and reviews what enabled that attention.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Did you spend any protected attention on the thing you chose, and what made that easier or harder?
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Name your own visual reactions
mappings.rationale: Comparing visible features makes personal creative judgments more specific without universalizing them.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether you can explain a preference more specifically. Your association may be personal or cultural; it does not establish what every audience feels.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Choose from an AI-generated creative pool
mappings.rationale: The person selects components and retains creative development instead of equating generation with authorship.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] State why each chosen element belongs. Fast generation and retained enjoyment do not establish improved independent creativity.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Review quality through a real user journey
mappings.rationale: Actual use and discussion of qualitative criteria reveal friction; improvements in the team's judgment remain a further claim.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Which disagreement changed the quality criterion or uncovered something a score concealed? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Explain the other side before deciding
mappings.rationale: Participants explain and check each other's reasons before a named decision maker resolves the choice.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Did the discussion reveal a real trade-off or merely produce agreement? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Keep a decision and outcome log
mappings.rationale: Preserved prior reasoning can be compared with results, including right predictions reached for wrong reasons.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice wrong reasons behind right predictions as well as wrong outcomes. Count uncertainty and missing information, not only wins.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Outline the argument before making slides
mappings.rationale: The person shapes the sequence of claims before formatting makes a presentation feel complete.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Did a headline or transition reveal a missing reason or unsupported claim? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Answer, example, relevance
mappings.rationale: A direct answer, example and relevance statement are practiced for a real listener rather than judged by fluency alone.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Did the example clarify the answer, or distract from an unanswered question? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Record a lived moment each day
mappings.rationale: Brief dated observations supply personally sourced material while separating current events from older memories.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Which details would you otherwise have forgotten, and which interpretations need checking? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Speak your thoughts before summarizing them with AI
mappings.rationale: The person articulates concerns and checks the AI summary against their own priorities.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether the action list reflects your priorities rather than merely the easiest items to summarize.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Listen before shaping the message
mappings.rationale: Actual audience input changes the message and the requested action before presentation polish.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] What changed because you heard from the audience rather than imagined them? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Review survey questions against the decision
mappings.rationale: Question revision aims at interpretable responses; a better survey does not itself establish better reasoning by its author.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Can you explain what you would do differently for each answer? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Practice choosing the questions that change the plan
mappings.rationale: Low-stakes practice links each selected question to the later choices its answer changes.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Can you show the downstream choice changed by each question? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Return to real user accounts when AI ideas distract
mappings.rationale: Real user accounts inform whether an attractive AI possibility deserves a change of priorities.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Notice whether the proposal answers a user need or merely copies a visible feature. Interviews support judgment; they do not automatically validate demand.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Explain the algorithm you are responsible for
mappings.rationale: A product owner explains objectives and inputs with implementers before exercising responsibility.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] Can the accountable product owner explain an important trade-off and show how it is checked? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.

mappings.title: Rehearse a talk by compressing and expanding it
mappings.rationale: Compressing and expanding a talk clarifies its essential meaning while the person repeatedly performs the delivery.
mappings.observable_check: [Inference] What stayed essential across versions, and can a listener state it back? This is a proposed observation, not a validated measure.
mappings.fit_note: This is an intended benefit. The source does not directly evaluate this complete routine.
